findings.location: Revision has a hard budget, first paragraph, second sentence
findings.problem: The claim that restarting review at Evidence ensures that all four lenses examine the revised text is not faithful to the documented routing: a PM-validated must-fix at Evidence, Story, or Clarity stops the remaining lenses for that candidate, so not every revised candidate is examined by all four lenses.
findings.suggested_direction: Qualify the claim to say that review restarts at Evidence and proceeds through the lenses in order unless a PM-validated must-fix stops the remaining reviews for that candidate.
